title_en: Israeli police kill Palestinian in Jerusalem as army blocks aid for Qusra
excerpt_en: Israeli forces bar Israeli and Palestinian activists from delivering food and medicine to homes besieged by settlers.

title_en: Villagers vow to rebuild despite devastating mass demolition in West Bank
excerpt_en: Israeli forces' demolition of 12 homes in Khirbet al-Tabban leaves villagers determined to stand firm on their land.

title_en: West Bank: UN rights report warns of forcible displacement from three refugee camps
excerpt_en: Israeli security forces forcibly displaced the entire population of three Palestine refugee camps in the occupied West Bank in January and February last year – and continue to prevent their return, in violation of international law, according to a new report by the UN human rights office, OHCHR.

title_en: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village
excerpt_en: Al-Mughayyir's council says they were trying to stop settlers stealing sheep, but the Israeli military says they threw stones at its troops.

title_en: Lebanon–Israel tensions escalate as Gaza sees major aid delivery
excerpt_en: Peacekeepers in Lebanon have reported a marked deterioration in the security situation along the Blue Line of separation, with Israeli forces intensifying their military footprint in violation of a landmark Security Council resolution, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Thursday.

title_en: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
excerpt_en: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

title_en: Israel says Hamas security chief captured as strikes kill four during Gaza raid
excerpt_en: The Israeli military says it carried out strikes in Gaza City during a raid by special forces to capture the head of Hamas's internal security service.

title_en: Food aid cutback in the occupied West Bank as health fears grow in Gaza
excerpt_en: Lack of funding has forced the World Food Programme (WFP) to slash aid to families in the West Bank by half even though needs have more than doubled over the past two years.

title_en: Four children killed as separate attacks in Gaza destroy aid supplies
excerpt_en: Israeli attacks killed four children and destroyed humanitarian aid supplies in what turned out to be a deadly week in war-ravaged Gaza, the UN emergency relief agency, OCHA, said on Friday.

title_en: Aid reaches hundreds of thousands in Gaza amid severe food insecurity
excerpt_en: As hunger deepens across Gaza, humanitarian agencies continue to deliver food and other essential supplies to families in need.

title_en: After Israeli seizure of Kalandia training centre, UNRWA warns of impact on youth
excerpt_en: The seizure of a vocational training centre in occupied East Jerusalem has left hundreds of Palestinian young people without access to skills and training that could help shape their futures.

title_en: Security Council LIVE: Rising tensions in Gaza, West Bank
excerpt_en: Amid illegal Israeli settlement surges, continued attacks in Gaza and the West Bank alongside tensions throughout Occupied Palestinian Territory, the Security Council discussed the latest developments on Wednesday, with the UN Special Envoy stressing that “human dignity must be at the centre of all efforts” to overcome the current fragile ceasefire and continued suffering. title_en: Gaza: Children still at risk despite drop in acute hunger
excerpt_en: Among tent cities pitched on the rubble of destroyed homes in Gaza, children are, by one measure, finally getting enough to eat. By another, however, many of them may never fully recover, according to a new study by the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) released on Monday.

title_en: How Israel is expanding settlements in drive to reshape West Bank
excerpt_en: There has been a significant expansion of building and road construction on Palestinian land occupied by Israel in recent years.

title_en: Middle East: 94 per cent need shelter in Gaza, Israel ramps up demolitions in Lebanon
excerpt_en: Ninety-four cent of Gaza’s 2.1 million residents need shelter as Israeli gunfire and strikes continue inside the enclave, UN agencies and peacekeepers warned on Thursday.

title_en: Raising alarm over new illegal Israeli outposts, UN condemns attacks, incitement against Palestinians
excerpt_en: Reports of new illegal Israeli outposts in the occupied West Bank raised alarms at UN Headquarters on Wednesday while the UN rights office called on Israel to condemn its national security minister’s words that incite “violence amounting to atrocity crimes” against Palestinians.

title_en: Families' agonising search for answers as thousands still missing in Gaza
excerpt_en: Ten months after a ceasefire was declared, thousands of Palestinians in Gaza are still reported missing.

title_en: Gaza: Only three per cent of cropland available to grow food
excerpt_en: Amid ongoing deadly hostilities in Gaza, the enclave’s farmers face the increasingly difficult challenge of finding safe land to grow their crops.

title_en: Qusra siege eases as UN reaches trapped families, but crisis deepens in Gaza
excerpt_en: Humanitarian workers have reached Palestinian families who had been trapped for days by Israeli settlers in Qusra village in the northern West Bank, the UN said on Monday, as officials warned that the standoff must not become "the new normal."

title_en: Netanyahu's rejection of Trump's 15-point Gaza plan unlikely to be final word
excerpt_en: The Trump administration is said to be unbothered by the Israeli prime minister's rejection of the deal, viewing it as campaign rhetoric ahead of a general election.

title_en: 'Digital lifeline' - Gaza tech workers give glimpse of possible future
excerpt_en: Thousands of young people in Gaza are pursuing roles in the digital economy as the territory's wider recovery stalls.
